setup.title: Setup wizard
setup.disabled: Setup is switched off because no setup token is configured on the server. Set SETUP_TOKEN, or create the first operator from the command line.
setup.unavailable: Could not read the setup status. Check that the API is running, then reload this page.

welcome.title: Let's get {app} running.
welcome.intro: Seven simple steps, about three minutes total. We'll verify your server, check your database, confirm every default the admin console needs, link the Node bridge, and create your first super-admin login.

before.database: A PostgreSQL 16 database this deployment can reach, with its migrations applied.
before.runtime: Node.js 22 or newer and Redis running next to the API.
before.token: The setup token from your deployment configuration (SETUP_TOKEN).

welcome.tokenHint: Proves you control this deployment. It is checked again by every step.

licence.title: Verify your purchase.
licence.intro: Enter your CodeCanyon purchase code. We validate it with Envato before installing — installation can't continue without a valid code.
licence.label: Purchase code
licence.help: Find it in your CodeCanyon account → Downloads → the License certificate & purchase code.
licence.verified: Purchase already verified — you can continue.

requirements.title: Server requirements.
requirements.intro: We're checking the host meets the minimum bar before installing.
requirements.fixNotice: Fix the items marked in coral before continuing. The Continue button stays disabled until everything passes.
requirements.loadFailed: Could not run the requirements check.

database.title: Database connection.
database.intro: Check the PostgreSQL database this platform runs on. We'll verify the connection before moving on.
database.name: Database name
database.passwordHint: Leave blank to use this deployment's own password. The connection itself is set in the server's environment; this step only tests it.
database.unreachable: Could not reach PostgreSQL over any route. Use the exact host your hosting panel shows, check the port, confirm the database and user exist and that the server accepts connections from this machine, then retry.

application.title: Application basics.
application.intro: Name your install, set the public URL, and pick a timezone + default language.
application.name: Application name

admin.title: Admin account.
admin.intro: Your first super-admin login + private workspace. Add teammates later from the console.
admin.note: Min. 12 chars with upper, lower, number and symbol · argon2id-hashed. This platform is multi-tenant — one private workspace ships pre-configured; rename it later in Workspaces. Your password is never stored in plain text, and it must be paired with two-factor sign-in at first login.

node.title: Node bridge.
node.intro: WhatsApp is sent through a small Node service. Point the platform at it and set the shared token — the installer saves it for both sides.
node.urlHint: Where your Node bridge listens. The API calls this to send messages.
node.portHint: The port the Node bridge binds to.
node.tokenHint: Auto-filled. Must match in the API and the Node bridge — the installer saves it once, sealed.
node.info: These are saved in the platform settings, not in .env files. The token is shared as NODE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN with the Node bridge.

install.title: Installing {app}.
install.intro: Sit tight — we're configuring everything. This usually takes a few seconds.

configuration.active: Saving the application and Node bridge configuration…

account.active: Creating admin account and private workspace…

finalize.active: Locking setup and recording the install…

completed.body: Setup has already been completed on this deployment.

problems.disabled: Setup is disabled on this server.
problems.outOfOrder: A step ran out of order. Reload the page and start again.
problems.step: Installation step failed. Check your details and the server logs, then try again.
problems.prerequisites: The server is not ready for setup: {items}.

licence.unreachable: Could not reach Envato to verify the code. Check the server's internet connection.

licence.other_product: This purchase code is for a different product.
licence.unknown: The purchase code could not be verified.

system.title: Application updater
system.description: Verify your purchase and see exactly what this deployment is running. Updates ship as a new image and migrations run before it starts — your database, storage and uploads are never touched from this page.

licence.title: Verify your purchase
licence.intro: Enter your CodeCanyon purchase code. It is validated with Envato before any update can run.
licence.notEnabled: This deployment does not enforce a purchase code, so there is nothing to verify here.
licence.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can verify the purchase code.

reasons.not_configured: Licence check is not configured (missing Envato token).
reasons.unreachable: Could not reach Envato to verify the code. Check the server's internet connection.
reasons.not_found: Invalid purchase code — Envato has no sale for it.
reasons.other_product: This purchase code is for a different product.
reasons.unknown: The purchase code could not be verified.

step2.title: Back up the database
step2.body: Take a database backup (pg_dump or point-in-time recovery) before deploying. Backups are an infrastructure job here, not a button.

step3.title: Deploy the new image
step3.body: Roll out the new container image. The running version and build are shown below.

step4.title: Run migrations
step4.body: pnpm db:migrate applies new tables and columns and never removes data. The ledger below lists every migration and its state.

step5.title: Health check
step5.body: Dependencies are checked live below. Refresh this page after the deploy to confirm everything is up.
